note: Weekly video cast (KT, 27 Nov 2026: don't reuse one presenter, background and voice every time). Rule: a small recurring cast, each presenter ALWAYS with their own voice (a face and voice that match keep trust; research: spokes-character studies, Ehrenberg-Bass). The setting, outfit and framing change every video; no presenter+setting pair repeats within 8 weeks. Scripts are written for the chosen presenter's persona and setting. New presenters are generated in BHuman inside the monthly credit budget; add them here with their BHuman ids once made. Hypothesis to test, not established.

decisions.decision: Keep the current cast; presenter ethnicity is not changed by default.
decisions.evidence: Eisend, Rossner & Hermann 2025 (J. Marketing) meta-analysis: 106 papers, 1,276 effect sizes, 21 countries, ethnic diversity effects 'small' and context-dependent, larger for ethnic minorities within a country; Alden, Steenkamp & Batra 1999 (J. Marketing) global consumer culture positioning used across Asia. Claude's earlier 'viewers identify more with presenters like them' overstated the evidence.
decisions.test_later: Presenter look may be one tested variable once there are about 1,000 views per variant; never a default change.
